name: The Pelican
descriptionLong: The Pelican offers a spacious layout perfect for families or roommates. With three bedrooms and two bathrooms, this plan provides ample space for everyone to enjoy. The open-concept living area is ideal for entertaining guests or relaxing after a long day.

name: The Falcon
descriptionLong: The Falcon is a stylish and efficient two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment that maximizes space without sacrificing comfort. Perfect for young professionals or small families, this plan features modern amenities and a well-designed layout.

name: The Raven
descriptionLong: The Raven is a contemporary two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment that combines functionality with style. With a focus on open living spaces and natural light, this plan is perfect for those who appreciate modern design and comfort.

name: The Sparrow
descriptionLong: The Sparrow is a spacious three-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment designed for families or roommates seeking comfort and convenience. This plan features a large living area, modern kitchen, and ample storage space to meet all your needs.
